description: Index of the v247 source checkpoint: the state of the Thor port (Xiaomi 12S Ultra, SM8475, iPadOS 18.7.10 / 22H374) as built and analysed on 2026-11-28, eleven versions after thor-v236. See docs/thor-v247-source-checkpoint.md.
device_repositories: unchanged since thor-v236: the Pong SM8475 device working tree is at the same HEAD (760be3f) with the same 19 modified and 27 new files, and the Thor 18 device repository has the same one change; checkpoints/thor-v236/pong-device and checkpoints/thor-v236/unixnu-thor-18 still describe them.
kept_local: signed runtime libraries and the three generated payload headers
logs, snapshots, panic records and photographs (they name the device)
home directory paths, the phone's fastboot serial and the name of the office wireless network (replaced by THOR_ROOT, THOR_TOOLS, THOR_SERIAL and a placeholder)
